metadata.scope: The data states the srch mind map's behaviours require. Every CREATE row points at an EXISTING seeder (seed:barcode, seed:rbac) and @td() alias; store-setting states are reached by the case's own Steps; nothing here is seeded by a new mechanism.

The two families of store states are deliberately separate requirements.
